children: China’s imports jumped 28.2% year-on-year to USD 282.4 billion in August 2026, accelerating from a 27.5% increase in July and extending double-digit growth for an eighth consecutive month.
However, the latest reading fell short of market expectations for a 30% rise.
In January–August, imports increased 27.0% from the same period in 2025 to USD 2.11 trillion.

title: China Import Growth Remain Solid
